listening.title: A product demo for a new client

lines.speaker: Linh (Sales Executive)
lines.text: Thank you for your time. Today I will give you a short walkthrough of our platform.

lines.speaker: Tuan (Operations Manager)
lines.text: Great. We mainly want to see how it handles our monthly orders.

lines.speaker: Linh (Sales Executive)
lines.text: I tailored the demo script to that, so we will start with the order screen.

lines.speaker: Tuan (Operations Manager)
lines.text: Is this real data? Our numbers are quite different from a normal example.

lines.speaker: Linh (Sales Executive)
lines.text: This is a sandbox with your sample file, so everything should look familiar to you.

lines.speaker: Tuan (Operations Manager)
lines.text: That helps a lot. What is the feature highlight you mentioned on the phone?

lines.speaker: Linh (Sales Executive)
lines.text: Automatic approval. Your manager can approve an order from a phone in one click.

lines.speaker: Tuan (Operations Manager)
lines.text: And can it work with the accounting software we already use?

lines.speaker: Linh (Sales Executive)
lines.text: Yes. The integration usually takes two weeks, and we can run a proof of concept first.

lines.speaker: Tuan (Operations Manager)
lines.text: Good. So the main takeaway is much less manual work for my team.
